t_advice_summary_textbox.text: play one group (pink/purple/brown vs. blue/green/yellow) while it's giving higher numbers until it flips to giving lower numbers, then switch to the other color group until it flips, then flip back.

vb_textbox.text: There are two color groups - red/pink/purple/brown and blue/green/yellow/orange - find which one is performing better and stick with that one. It will start to decrease return incrementally, and once it gets down to 1 or 0, switch over to the other color group.  Continue to select the better performing color group until the return winds down and then swap to the other group.
